claim: E-1 through E-3 in barracks draw no BAH
quote: Every Marine is entitled to a type of BAH
correctedFix: A Marine without dependents in single-type government quarters draws BAH-Partial. A barracks Marine paying child support at or above the BAH-Diff rate draws BAH-Diff instead. Only BAH at the with or without-dependent locality rate is absent.
note: Downgraded from blocker. BAH-Partial posts automatically at accession, so the pay harm is small. The page still teaches a false rule.

claim: OHA covers move-in and move-out costs
quote: MIHA does not cover move-out costs.
correctedFix: OHA includes MIHA for move-in costs only, paid for one dwelling per tour at a PDS unless a government-funded local move occurs. No allowance covers move-out costs.
note: Downgraded to minor. Factual error with low pay impact.

claim: Partial BAH applies only in narrow government-quarters, transitional or duty situations
quote: BAH-Partial is paid to a Service member without a dependent who is assigned to single-type Government quarters
correctedFix: BAH-Partial is the standing entitlement of every member without dependents assigned to single-type government quarters and not authorized BAH or OHA. Para 5.5.3 adds the confinement, arrest, hospital, between-PDS and dual-military cases.

claim: Partial BAH is not common
quote: BAH Partial is automatically credited to the MMPA during the recruit accession process.
correctedFix: Delete the sentence. BAH-Partial is the default for every barracks Marine without dependents and posts automatically at accession.

claim: In government quarters BAH typically does not apply
quote: A housing allowance, other than BAH-Partial or BAH-Diff, is generally not authorized for a Service member who is assigned to Government quarters
correctedFix: In adequate government quarters no BAH pays at the locality rate. A member without dependents in single-type quarters draws BAH-Partial, and a member paying qualifying child support draws BAH-Diff.
note: Downgraded to minor. The word typically hedges. The defect is the missing exceptions.

claim: Member in government quarters gets no BAH
quote: A housing allowance, other than BAH-Partial or BAH-Diff, is generally not authorized
correctedFix: Member in adequate government quarters draws no BAH at the locality rate. BAH-Partial or BAH-Diff still pays when the member qualifies.

claim: BAH continues at home port for all sea-duty Marines
quote: cannot elect not to occupy assigned shipboard Government quarters and receive BAH or OHA
correctedFix: A member with dependents draws the with-dependent rate for the home port on a CO statement of dependent residence (10.2.2.5.1). A member without dependents in E-6 and above elects BAH or OHA. A member without dependents below E-6 occupies shipboard quarters and draws BAH-Partial unless the Secretary of the Navy authorizes BAH or OHA under 10.1.5.2.
note: The Sep 2026 revision of 10.1 added the Secretary authority for junior enlisted on sea duty.

claim: Reservists on active duty receive standard BAH
quote: called or ordered to AD for 30 or fewer days, and the duty is not in support of a contingency operation, then start BAH-RC
correctedFix: A reservist on orders of 30 or fewer days, not for a contingency, draws BAH-RC. Orders of 31 or more days, or contingency orders of any length, pay BAH or OHA at the primary residence.

claim: BAH applies during AT or orders over 30 days
quote: then start BAH-RC on the first day of AD
correctedFix: AT and other orders of 30 or fewer days pay BAH-RC. BAH or OHA starts on orders of 31 or more days or on contingency orders of any length.

claim: Partial BAH on an off-base member is an error, upgrade to full BAH
paragraph: Ch 26 5.5.3.2.7, 10.1.3, 10.1.4, MCO 11000.22 Encl 2 Ch 10 par 7c, 7e and Option to elect BAH
quote: In grade E-6 or below, is without a dependent, and is offered an assignment of adequate Government quarters
correctedFix: Check entitlement before upgrading. A Marine E-5 and below without dependents who is offered adequate quarters and lives off base at own expense stays on BAH-Partial. Full BAH needs Installation Commander approval for non-availability or an approved exception. E-6 and above elect off base without approval under MCO 11000.22 Ch 10, unless military necessity applies.
note: Finding fix said E-6 or below. MCO 11000.22 extends the CONUS election to E-6, so the USMC BAH-Partial population is E-5 and below.

claim: OHA reimburses utilities and other housing costs
quote: The utility and recurring maintenance allowance for each OHA locality is based on the with-dependent reported expenses
correctedFix: The utility and recurring maintenance allowance is a fixed locality amount paid when rent excludes utilities or the member owns the home. It is not receipt-based reimbursement. A utility point score reduces it when rent includes some utilities.

claim: Utility allowance equals average utility costs
quote: It covers the utility costs for 80% of the Service members assigned to an area.
correctedFix: Set at a locality amount covering utility costs for 80 percent of members in the area. A member without dependents who is not a sharer receives 75 percent of the with-dependent amount. Sharers receive a prorated amount.

claim: Member submits utility cost documentation for the utility allowance
quote: When rent does not include utilities, or the Service member is a homeowner, the Service member is authorized the utility and recurring maintenance allowance.
correctedFix: Remove the utility receipt requirement. Document on the DD 2367 which utilities the rent includes so the utility point score is correct.

claim: Member submits move-in receipts for MIHA
quote: All Service members, with or without dependents, receive the full allowance with their first OHA rental payment.
correctedFix: No change required. Optional clarification. MIHA/Miscellaneous is a lump sum with no receipts. MIHA/Rent, Security, Infectious Disease and Safety need receipts.
note: Refuted. Four of the five MIHA types require receipts, so the bullet holds for the claims a member submits.

claim: Annual lease renewal documentation required
quote: Re-compute OHA if and when the rent changes.
correctedFix: Replace with a new DD 2367 and lease documents whenever rent or the dwelling changes so OHA is recomputed. Ch 26 sets no annual lease renewal requirement.

claim: PAC verifies the lease meets OHA standards
quote: The senior officer of the Uniformed Services in the country concerned, or the individuals or offices designated for that purpose by the senior officer, has approval authority.
correctedFix: The in-country senior officer or the designated housing office approves the DD 2367. PAC reports OHA after approval.

claim: Per MCO 7220.56, partial BAH applies in limited situations
quote: ENTITLEMENT TO BASIC ALLOWANCE FOR HOUSING (BAH) AT LOCATIONS OTHER THAN PERMANENT DUTY STATION (PDS)
correctedFix: Cite DoDFMR Vol 7A Ch 26 para 5.5 for BAH-Partial. MCO 7220.56A covers BAH waivers away from the PDS and contains no BAH-Partial rule.
note: MCO 7220.56A text contains no occurrence of partial.

claim: Single SNCO is E-7 and above for BAH, per MCO 7220.56
paragraph: Ch 26 10.1.3, 10.1.4, MCO 11000.22 Encl 2 Ch 10 Option to elect BAH
quote: E-6 and above are not required to gain Installation Commander's approval prior to residing off base
correctedFix: Cite Ch 26 10.1.3 and MCO 11000.22 Ch 10. Ch 26 gives E-7 and above the election at any time. MCO 11000.22 extends the CONUS election to E-6 without Installation Commander approval, subject to military necessity.
note: Finding fix limited E-6 to inadequate quarters per FMR 10.1.4. The Marine Corps extends the election to E-6, so the corrected fix names both rules.

claim: Junior enlisted exceptions are command hardship and health cases per MCO 7220.56
quote: Installation Commanders may approve exceptions that do not meet the criteria in paragraph 7d above to preclude undue hardship on individual Marines.
correctedFix: Cite MCO 11000.22 Encl 2 Ch 10 par 7c to 7e. The Installation Commander approves BAH without dependents for non-availability at 95 percent occupancy, the 7d allowable exceptions, and 7e hardship exceptions.

claim: Quarters used for command convenience have specific situations
quote: considered assigned, suitable, and adequate whenever occupied by a Service member at the PDS without payment of rental charges
correctedFix: Delete the line. Ch 26 has no command-convenience category.

claim: MCRAMM Chapter 12 is the reserve BAH authority
quote: Basic Allowance for Housing and Basic Allowance for Subsistence (BAH and BAS)
correctedFix: Cite DoDFMR Vol 7A Ch 26 para 10.5. MCRAMM addresses BAH in Chapter 7 par 3. Chapter 12 covers other programs.

claim: OHA stops on CONUS return and BAH starts at the CONUS station
quote: start BAH-Transit the day the Service member departs the OHA area through the day before the Service member reports to the new PDS
correctedFix: Pay OHA through the day before departure. Pay BAH-Transit from departure through the day before reporting, TDY en route included. Start BAH at the new PDS on the reporting day.

claim: Ch 26 section 6.0 requires annual OHA review
quote: Re-compute OHA if and when the rent changes.
correctedFix: Remove the Ch 26 attribution for an annual review. Ch 26 requires recompute on any rent change. Name local OHA audit procedures as the source for any periodic review.

claim: Post BAH at the with or without dependents rate
quote: The entitlement may be BAH Partial, BAH (formally BAQ and VHA) with or without dependents
correctedFix: Post the housing entitlement the join supports. BAH with or without dependents off base, BAH-Partial or BAH-Diff in single-type quarters, BAH-RC for reserve orders of 30 or fewer days, OHA at an overseas PDS.

claim: BAH supporting documents include the lease
quote: is paid independently of a Service member's actual housing costs.
correctedFix: BAH supporting documents are the NAVMC 10922 with dependency documents and the quarters status. A lease supports OHA only.

claim: BAH zip code comes from PCS orders or quarters address
quote: The ZIP Code of the Marine's PDS and the designator 'M' will be used
correctedFix: Report the PDS zip with designator M. Report the dependent zip with designator D only under an approved waiver or unaccompanied tour. A quarters address sets no BAH rate.

claim: Post BAH stop on the quarters move-in date
quote: A housing allowance continues to accrue through the day before a Service member is assigned Government quarters
correctedFix: Stop BAH effective the day before quarters assignment. A Marine without dependents moving into single-type quarters starts BAH-Partial on the assignment date.

claim: Delayed pay post creates a member debt
quote: a with-dependent housing allowance is authorized as of the date the dependent is acquired.
correctedFix: A late start produces back pay owed to the Marine. Debt forms when an entry posts at a rate above entitlement or a stop posts late.

claim: Retroactive starts often post at wrong rate and create debt
quote: The higher rate is not retroactive unless the Service member's commander certifies
correctedFix: Tie debt risk to the rate posted and to late stops, not to a delayed start. A missed PDS recertification restarts the with-dependent rate on the certification date without retroactive pay unless the commander certifies.

claim: DEERS dependency change requires a BAS code audit
quote: Enlisted BAS rates will be applied uniformly for all enlisted members
correctedFix: Audit BAH and, where the Marine draws it, BNA. BAS does not vary with dependency.

claim: Ch 26 requires a per-cycle BAH and BAS dependency cross-check
quote: the Services must maintain adequate levels of internal audit to assure the legality, propriety, and correctness of all housing allowance payments.
correctedFix: Attribute the per-cycle cadence to local SOP. Ch 26 requires adequate internal audit without a set cycle. Remove BAS from the misalignment.

claim: Inbound duty location, grade and dependent status drive BAH
quote: Ordinarily, a housing allowance is based on the Service member's PDS
correctedFix: No change required. Optional note on the waiver and unaccompanied tour exceptions.
note: Refuted. The page states the ordinary rule and the source uses the same rule.

claim: FSA applies on separation over 30 days
quote: do not live in the vicinity of the member's homeport/PDS, and their transportation to or near the PDS is not authorized at government expense
correctedFix: The 30-day test applies to FSA-S and FSA-T. FSA-R pays on a PCS where dependent travel to the PDS is not authorized at government expense, with no 30-day minimum.

claim: BAH Dependent Election Form per Ch 26
quote: Marine Corps Members must make an application for any dependent to be added into MCTFS for entitlement to BAH.
correctedFix: Name the NAVMC 10922 dependency application per MCO 1751.3. Secondary dependents use the DD Form 137.

claim: FSA applies when separation exceeds 30 days
quote: do not live in the vicinity of the member's homeport/PDS
correctedFix: Limit the 30-day test to FSA-S and FSA-T. FSA-R carries no 30-day minimum.

claim: BAH Dependent Election Form per Ch 26
quote: Marine Corps Members must make an application for any dependent
correctedFix: Name the NAVMC 10922. Ch 26 has no election form.

claim: BAH rate not updated at 1 January is a pitfall
quote: must not be reduced due to changes in housing costs in the MHA
correctedFix: No change required. Optional note to keep the protected rate when the locality rate drops.
note: Refuted. A missed annual increase is a real pitfall and the page states no wrong rule.

claim: With versus without dependents is the BAH decision point
quote: The BAH-Diff rate is a fixed, non-locality-based rate
correctedFix: Add BAH-Partial and BAH-Diff for members in single-type quarters and BAH-Transit for members between PDSs.

claim: TLE covers lodging at the gaining station only
quote: Before leaving the old PDS or designated place, and upon arrival at the new PDS, designated place, or first PDS.
correctedFix: TLE covers CONUS temporary lodging near the old PDS, a designated place, or the new PDS. It pays up to 21 days on a move to a CONUS PDS and up to 7 days at CONUS locations on a move OCONUS.

claim: BAH location code matches duty station
quote: When the dependent remains at the Service member's old PDS, the housing allowance is paid based on the old PDS.
correctedFix: Location matches the PDS unless an approved waiver or unaccompanied tour sets the dependent location with designator D. Do not correct those Marines to the PDS.
note: Downgraded to minor. A checklist omission, not a false rule.

claim: Old housing area after a move within the duty station is an error
quote: Ordinarily, a housing allowance is based on the Service member's PDS
correctedFix: Delete. A move within the PDS vicinity does not change the BAH rate. The rate keys to the PDS zip with designator M, not the residence.
note: Downgraded to minor. A phantom error type with no pay loss. The same defect sits at content/marines/bah.mdx line 342 Error 3, not in the finding list.

claim: Failure to recertify produces suspension and overpayment exposure
quote: A housing allowance at the with-dependent rate is authorized effective the date the Service member provides proper certification.
correctedFix: No change required. Optional. State the with-dependent rate stops at month end and restarts without retroactive pay.
note: Refuted. Suspension and overpayment exposure are both accurate outcomes under 3.2.3.1 and 3.2.3.2.

claim: Annual certification does not apply to primary dependents
quote: An RC member must recertify each dependent's status at least every third year
correctedFix: Add the RC rule. Reserve Component Marines recertify each dependent at least every third year or on a status change, whichever comes first.
note: Accurate for the active component. The defect is the missing RC trigger.

claim: Marine with old BAH location after PCS loses money every month
quote: start BAH or OHA based on the new PDS the day the Service member reports to the new PDS.
correctedFix: Say the Marine draws the wrong rate. The new PDS rate runs higher or lower than the old one, so the error is an underpayment or a debt.

claim: A 12-month error always produces back pay
quote: the member will be indebted for any amount of with-dependent housing allowance received after the dependency relationship ended
correctedFix: Split by direction. An underpayment repays the Marine. An overpayment creates a debt. A missed PDS recertification is not retroactive without commander certification.

claim: Submission goes to the DFAS processing office
paragraph: MCO 1751.3 Ch 1 par 1.h, 11, 12, Ch 26 Tables 26-10 to 26-13
quote: Unit diary actions for secondary dependents can only be accomplished by the CMC (MFP-1)
correctedFix: Route the DD 137 package through the S-1 or IPAC to CMC (MFP-1), the DEERS and Dependency Support Section. The Commandant determines USMC secondary dependency.

claim: AskDFAS or U.S. Mail are the submission paths
paragraph: Ch 26 Tables 26-10 to 26-13 USMC rows, MARADMIN 311/25 par 2 and 3
quote: the Commandant of the Marine Corps makes the determination
correctedFix: Replace with the USMC path. The Marine completes the DD 137 with the S-1 and the command forwards it to CMC (MFP-1). The DFAS site serves as a criteria reference only.

claim: Marine starts the package at the 90-day mark
quote: CMC (MFP-1) will initiate the annual recertification for all Secondary Dependents.
correctedFix: CMC (MFP-1) initiates the annual recertification and the Marine answers it by the suspense. Keep the tracker and stage evidence early.

claim: Secondary dependency gives increased BAH up to the with-dependent ceiling
quote: Basic Allowance for Housing (BAH) not to exceed full BAH with dependents
correctedFix: Say the with-dependent rate adds pay only when the secondary dependent is the Marine's sole dependent. A Marine already at the with-dependent rate gains no BAH.
note: The ceiling wording matches the DD 137. The word increased misleads Marines already drawing for a spouse or child.

claim: Debt typically forms during the lapse period
quote: the member will be indebted for any amount of with-dependent housing allowance received after the dependency relationship ended
correctedFix: Say a debt forms when BAH pays past a status change or a period of inadequate support. A lapse in recertification suspends benefits through CMC (MFP-1).

claim: IPAC routes to the HQMC Dependency Determination Section
quote: Headquarters Marine Corps, DEERS and Dependency Support Section (MFP-1)
correctedFix: Rename to the DEERS and Dependency Support Section (MFP-1).

claim: Effective date 2024-03-04
quote: This new policy is effective upon release of this MARADMIN.
correctedFix: Set effectiveDate to 2024-03-06, the release date. Pay reaches back to the start of the class for Marines already attending.

claim: Message aligns travel and HHG entitlements with the JTR
quote: per diem equal to the amount of the basic allowance for housing at the without-dependent rate
correctedFix: State the purpose. It implements 37 USC 453(i), starts FSH-B at the without-dependent rate for the PME or training PDS via TTC 388/002, and keeps the with-dependent rate at the dependent location. No FSA authority.

claim: Marines on PCS orders to PME apply the PCS framework
quote: member with dependents who receives PCS orders to a PME or training class in the continental United States
correctedFix: Add the eligibility limits. The Marine has dependents, holds CONUS orders of one year or less, the orders state the return to the prior station, and no government quarters are provided.

claim: Commanders approve BAH Without Dependents and CNAs
paragraph: MCO 11000.22 Encl 2 Ch 10 par 7c, Ch 10 Option to elect BAH, Ch 11 par 6
quote: Authority for entitlement to BAH rest solely with the Installation Commander
correctedFix: Name the Installation Commander as the BAH without dependents approver. E-6 and above electing off base need no approval. CNA numbers come from installation transient housing for TAD travelers per Ch 11 par 6.
note: Finding said CNAs have no archive source. MCO 11000.22 Ch 11 par 6 covers CNA numbers.

claim: BAH without dependents approval defined by local policy
quote: may only be approved, for reasons of non-availability of UH, when the occupancy rate across the installation is 95% or greater
correctedFix: State the rule. The Installation Commander approves BAH without dependents for non-availability only at 95 percent installation occupancy, or for a 7d or 7e exception. E-6 and above elect off base without approval. Replace the MCO P11000.22 paragraph 2600 citation.

claim: Old PDS rate stops on the detachment date
quote: A Service member's old PDS is the PDS for BAH purposes from the day the Service member departs the old PDS through the day before
correctedFix: Old PDS BAH continues through travel, leave and TDY en route until the day before reporting. New PDS BAH starts on the reporting day.
note: Downgraded from blocker. Wrong timing statement, no pay action follows from it.

claim: Non-custodial Marine paying the BAH-Diff rate gets BAH-Diff
quote: if a non-custodial Service member is not residing in or assigned to Government quarters and pays support for the child in an amount equal to or more than
correctedFix: Off base, a non-custodial Marine paying support at or above the BAH-Diff rate draws BAH at the with-dependent rate for the child. BAH-Diff applies only in single-type government quarters.
note: Kept blocker. Marines off base would claim a fraction of their entitlement.

claim: Sole custody to former spouse stops with-dependent BAH
quote: the Service member is authorized a housing allowance at the with-dependent rate based on the child.
correctedFix: Off base and paying support at or above the BAH-Diff rate, the Marine keeps the with-dependent rate. Below that amount, the without-dependent rate. In single-type quarters, BAH-Diff when support meets the rate.

claim: Rate protection on promotion carries across MHAs
quote: The current BAH rate at the current duty location becomes the Service member's new protected BAH rate.
correctedFix: Rewrite as: a promotion never lowers BAH at the current MHA. Protection does not follow the Marine to a new MHA.
note: Downgraded to minor. The garbled parenthetical conflicts with line 396 but the list item itself is correct.

claim: OHA and LQA not paid concurrently
quote: A Service member is entitled to OHA at the with-dependent rate even if the Service member's dependent spouse receives an LQA.
correctedFix: Delete the election claim. A Marine draws OHA at the with-dependent rate even when a civilian spouse draws LQA.

claim: FSH-B is a fixed CONUS rate
quote: FSH-B is payable in a monthly amount equal to the BAH without-dependent rate applicable to the Service member's grade and PDS.
correctedFix: FSH-B equals the locality BAH without-dependent rate for the Marine's grade and PDS.

claim: Privatized housing is treated as government quarters
quote: Each Service member occupying privatized housing is authorized a housing allowance in the same manner as a Service member not assigned to Government quarters.
correctedFix: Privatized housing is not government quarters. The Marine draws BAH as if off base and pays rent to the operator.

claim: BAH-Diff heading names a single custodial parent
quote: is considered a custodial parent for housing allowance purposes.
correctedFix: Rename the heading to BAH-Diff not started for a non-custodial Marine in the barracks. A custodial parent draws the with-dependent rate.

claim: BAH-Diff Marine confirms still without dependents
quote: Is paying child support and receiving BAH-Diff. The Service member is not without dependent.
correctedFix: Remove the line. A BAH-Diff Marine is not a member without dependents.

claim: Death of a dependent triggers immediate removal
quote: BAH or OHA at the with-dependent rate continues to be paid for up to one year to a Service member on AD whose sole dependent dies
correctedFix: When a sole dependent dies on or after 23 Dec 2022 while residing with the Marine on active duty, and the Marine is not in government quarters, the with-dependent rate continues up to one year. It ends early on the 10.2.4.2 triggers such as quarters assignment or a new dependent.

claim: BAH adjustment timing depends on submission date
quote: a with-dependent housing allowance is authorized as of the date the dependent is acquired.
correctedFix: Entitlement runs from the acquisition date. Late filing delays payment. A missed PDS recertification is the exception and restarts on the certification date.
note: Downgraded to minor. A one-line bullet.

claim: Demotion reduces BAH only below the protected rate
quote: If the Service member is demoted or loses authority for BAH, then the Service member's BAH rate protection at the current amount stops
correctedFix: On demotion, rate protection ends. BAH resets to the current rate for the lower grade at the MHA, which becomes the new protected rate.
note: Confirmed as contradicted, not only unsupported. 5.2 ends protection on demotion.

claim: Submit orders to new S-1 within 7 days
quote: The higher rate is not retroactive
correctedFix: Drop the 7 days. Recertify dependents on arrival at the new PDS. A missed recertification stops the with-dependent rate at month end and restarts without retroactive pay unless the commander certifies.
note: Downgraded to minor. Unsourced deadline, low harm.

claim: Annual recertification covers court-ordered BAH-Diff cases
quote: Annual re-determination of dependency is required for a member who claims a housing allowance for any Secondary Dependent.
correctedFix: Remove BAH-Diff cases from annual recertification here and at lines 70, 124 to 130 and 350. Support rises within 60 days of a BAH-Diff rate increase (3.3.2).
note: Downgraded to minor. Extra recertification causes no pay loss.

claim: Court-ordered BAH-Diff is an annual recert category
quote: Annual certification of financial and relationship status is required for a Service member who claims a housing allowance for a secondary dependent
correctedFix: Same as line 27. Remove the category.

claim: Custody or court-ordered support keeps with-dependent BAH
quote: the Service member is authorized a with-dependent housing allowance for the child only if the Service member provides proof of support
correctedFix: Split the cases. A custodial parent keeps the with-dependent rate. A non-custodial parent off base keeps it only while paying at least the BAH-Diff rate, with proof when the court order is below that amount.
note: Downgraded to minor. The page hedges with specific calculation depends.

claim: Cites Ch 26 May 2025 edition
quote: The previous version dated May 2025 is archived.
correctedFix: Update the reference to the September 2026 edition.

claim: BAH-RC/T on return from accompanied overseas tour
quote: A Marine returning to CONUS from accompanied tour overseas is entitled to BAH-RC/T
correctedFix: No change required. Optional note that Ch 26 names the entitlement BAH-Transit.
note: Refuted. The citation page restates the PRIUM text and the timing matches Table 26-38.

claim: BAH-Diff approximates the dependent-rate increment
quote: fixed, non-locality-based rate and is the difference between the with-dependent BAQ rate and the without-dependent BAQ rate
correctedFix: Say BAH-Diff is the 1997 BAQ difference indexed by pay raises, far below the current BAH difference. Off base the same support earns the full with-dependent rate.

claim: MIHA covers security deposits
quote: a payment made on a reimbursable basis to a Service member who incurs certain one-time, nonrefundable charges related to renting a dwelling.
correctedFix: Drop security deposits. List the five MIHA types, Miscellaneous, Rent, Security, Infectious Disease and Safety.

claim: Commanders certify BAH-Partial elections for E-6 and E-7
quote: may elect, at any time, not to occupy Government quarters at the PDS and is authorized BAH or OHA
correctedFix: The election yields full BAH or OHA, not BAH-Partial. Remove the BAH-Partial election wording.

claim: In loco parentis 5 years before sponsor's emancipation
quote: at any time for a continued period of at least five years before the member turned 21 years of age
correctedFix: Stood in place of a parent for a continuous period of at least five years before the Marine turned 21.

claim: Annual recert per MARADMIN 661/19
quote: CMC (MFP-1) will initiate the annual recertification for all Secondary Dependents.
correctedFix: Cite MCO 1751.3 Ch 1 par 8. MARADMIN 661/19 covers audit controls on the NAVMC 10922.

claim: Para 5.1.1 states the two-rate structure
quote: The BAH rate is based on median housing costs in the Military Housing Area (MHA) and is paid independently of a Service member's actual housing costs.
correctedFix: Cite the DTMO BAH rate tables for the with and without-dependent rates. Para 5.1.1 states the median housing cost basis only.

claim: Support of a primary dependent is automatically assumed
quote: is authorized a housing allowance on behalf of a primary dependent if the Service member contributes to the dependent's support, in an amount that is at least equal to the applicable BAH-Diff rate
correctedFix: Say support at or above the BAH-Diff rate is required. Proof comes into play when the Marine lives apart from the dependent.

claim: Stepparent relationship persists after death of biological parent
quote: but not necessarily upon the death of the Service member's biological parent. A stepparent may qualify as a secondary dependent
correctedFix: Say the stepparent relationship does not necessarily end at the parent's death and the stepparent qualifies as a secondary dependent on proof. Fix the paragraph number to 3.1.2.3.1.

claim: Promotion raises rate effective promotion date, prorated
quote: must not be reduced due to ... a Service member's promotion
correctedFix: No change required.
note: Refuted. The source does not contradict the page and the grade-based rate follows the promotion date.

claim: Protected rate resets on dependent change
quote: If the Service member is demoted or loses authority for BAH
correctedFix: No change required. Optional DTMO or JTR citation for the dependency-status condition.
note: Refuted. A dependency status change moves the Marine to a different rate type and ends protection at the old rate. Ch 26 is silent, not contrary.

claim: OHA utility allowance is a fixed amount by location
quote: It is paid to a Service member without a dependent, who is not a sharer, at 75% of the with-dependent rate.
correctedFix: No change required. Optional note on the 75 percent rate for members without dependents and the point-score reduction.
note: Refuted. The page statement matches 6.3.1.

claim: DTMO publishes OHA rates monthly
quote: OHA is based on cost reimbursement.
correctedFix: Drop the monthly claim or verify it against DTMO. Say DTMO adjusts OHA rental ceilings and currency factors on its own schedule.
note: No cached source supports a monthly cycle.

claim: FSH limited to unaccompanied or dependent-restricted tours
quote: a PDS (CONUS or OCONUS) to which concurrent dependent travel has been denied or deferred
correctedFix: Add deferred or denied concurrent travel and PME or training assignments of at least 140 and fewer than 365 days without dependents.

claim: PAA 06-20 covers BAH waivers
quote: The purpose of this PAA is to provide additional administrative guidance for documenting changes of Overseas Tour Extension Incentive Program (OTEIP) intensive authority
correctedFix: Say PAA 06-20 amplifies MARADMIN 320/20 with a Page 11 entry for OTEIP incentive changes. Cite MARADMIN 320/20 for the BAH waivers.
note: The PAA title names BAH waivers. The body covers OTEIP only.

claim: Dependent status updates within one pay period
quote: Substantiating documentation shall be submitted within 30 days of a life event
correctedFix: Submit documents and a new NAVMC 10922 within 30 days of the life event. Verify the change on the next LES.

claim: BAH traces back to DEERS
quote: Marine Corps Members must make an application for any dependent to be added into MCTFS for entitlement to BAH.
correctedFix: BAH runs on the NAVMC 10922 and MCTFS. DEERS drives ID cards and TRICARE.

claim: Joint custody BAH depends on who pays housing
quote: is considered a custodial parent for housing allowance purposes.
correctedFix: Use the custodial test. A Marine awarded primary physical custody, or whose child lives with the Marine at least half the calendar year, is the custodial parent.

claim: Support recertified annually
quote: When BAH-Diff rates increase, the minimum amount of support required increases to the new rate.
correctedFix: Remove annual recertification. Raise support within 60 days of a BAH-Diff rate increase and report any change in support obligation.

claim: Separation agreements do not affect spouse BAH
quote: the Service member must provide proof of support at the required level
correctedFix: No change required. Optional note on the support floor for a legally separated spouse.
note: Refuted. The page says separation agreements do not establish divorce, which holds. It makes no claim about support.

claim: DEERS errors can stop family pay
quote: Marine Corps Members must make an application for any dependent to be added into MCTFS
correctedFix: No change required.
note: Refuted. The source does not address DEERS impact and the hedged line states no false rule.

claim: Late submission creates pay debts
quote: If a Service member fails to report a change in dependency status that makes them no longer entitled to a with-dependent housing allowance, the member will be indebted
correctedFix: Say late loss reports create debts and late additions delay payment.

claim: BAH delayed start or unrecouped overpayment
quote: a with-dependent housing allowance is authorized as of the date the dependent is acquired.
correctedFix: No change required.
note: Refuted. Both outcomes occur. A late add delays the start and a late loss report leaves an overpayment.

claim: BAH-with-dependents not to exceed full BAH-with-dependents
quote: Basic Allowance for Housing (BAH) not to exceed full BAH with dependents
correctedFix: No change required.
note: Refuted. The page restates the DD 137 entitlement language.

claim: Dependents visit over 90 days ends dependent-locality BAH
quote: if the dependents visit at or near the member's PDS for more than 90 consecutive days, then the member is no longer entitled to BAH at the dependent locality rate
correctedFix: No change required.
note: Refuted. The citation page restates PRIUM 80201 par 8, and Ch 26 7.5.1 deems the dependents resident at the PDS on day 91.
